text.구성을 다른 도구 형식으로 미리 보고 지정한 폴더에 내보낸다: Previews configuration in other tools' formats and exports it to a folder you choose
text.내보내기 폴더 쓰기를 허용한 루트 하나(설치자만 등록, 웹에서 바꾸지 않: One root folder that exports may write to (only the server administrator registers it; it can't be changed from the web).
Name used when picking this folder on the export screen.
Set a name when you register a new folder.
Display name (leave empty to use the id).
text.내보낸 파일을 쓸 폴더(상대 경로는 설정 파일 폴더 기준). 있는 폴더여: Folder to write exported files to (relative paths are resolved from the settings file folder). The folder must already exist.
Change this to write exported files to a different folder.
text.설정 내보내기를 어디에 쓸 수 있는지 정합니다. 기본은 zip 내려받기만: Sets where exports can be written. By default, exports are only downloaded as a zip.
Places where writing to a folder is allowed. Leave empty to turn off folder writes (zip download only).
Use this when you want exported files written straight to a folder instead of a zip.
text.쓰기 금지 폴더를 찾을 홈(상대 경로는 설정 파일 폴더 기준). 비우면: Home folder used to find write-protected folders (relative paths are resolved from the settings file folder). Leave empty to use HOME or USERPROFILE.
text.홈 기준 쓰기 금지 폴더(외부 도구 원본). 허용 폴더로 등록해도 이 안: Write-protected folders under the home folder (other tools' originals). Nothing is written inside them, even if they're registered as writable folders.
Other write-protected folders (relative paths are resolved from the settings file folder).
text.내보내기 형식 이름 → 그 형식이 받는 옵션(키는 형식이 정한다, 예:: Export format name → options that format accepts (the format defines the keys, such as mapping and layout).
text.내보내기 화면에 허용 폴더의 전체 경로를 보일지(로컬 앱이라 기본 표시): Whether the export screen shows the full path of allowed folders (shown by default because this is a local app).
